ten.surface_rating.rationale: `surface` is a column of ten.matches (Sackmann `surface`), so the WEATHER_OBS>ten.court_speed_env (FREE_UNPROBED scraped speed pages) need was triggered only by the word 'surface'; match-level results, ranks and serve stats (2000-2026) are sufficient for the Elo; Challenger/ITF extension is optional.

ten.serve_return.rationale: `surface` is a column of ten.matches (Sackmann `surface`), so the WEATHER_OBS>ten.court_speed_env (FREE_UNPROBED scraped speed pages) need was triggered only by the word 'surface'; serve/return point-win rates come from per-match svpt, 1stWon, 2ndWon in ten.matches; ten.point_charting (SAMPLE_ONLY, charted subset) is not needed.

ten.h2h_style.rationale: Derived: H2H residual is defined against the pre-match surface Elo (own model), so it inherits ten.surface_rating; the style term uses ace-rate and return-points gaps from ten.serve_return.

ten.form.rationale: Derived: form is actual result minus rating-implied win probability, built from ten.surface_rating; raw data is only match results in ten.matches.

ten.fitness.rationale: Features are retirement/walkover history (RET/W/O in ten.matches scores, PIT-safe) plus medical-timeout flags from live score feeds, which no registry dataset holds (point_charting is not a timestamped medical-timeout feed); calibrates from ten.retirement_base_rate. EVENT>point_charting is the wrong dataset.

ten.fatigue.rationale: Travel zone change needs time zone/coordinates, which are in env.venue_geo (time zone, coordinates), not in ten.court_speed_env; minutes/sets/dates are in ten.matches (minutes column). The regression is on rating residuals, so it is derived from ten.surface_rating.

ten.format.rationale: `surface` is a column of ten.matches (Sackmann `surface`), so the  was triggered only by the word 'surface'; best_of and tournament level are in ten.matches; EVENT>ten.point_charting (sample-only) is spurious. Tiebreak/ad-scoring rules by event-year are a reference document to encode.

ten.set_dist.rationale: Derived: Markov model calibrated on set scores; inherits ten.hold_break. `surface` is a column of ten.matches (Sackmann `surface`), so the WEATHER_OBS>ten.court_speed_env (FREE_UNPROBED scraped speed pages) need was triggered only by the word 'surface'; set scores/match lengths are in ten.matches.

ten.court_cond.rationale: Definition needs event-year hold/ace/TB rates (ten.matches), forecast at start (env.weather_forecast_pit, history only from ~2022), altitude and roof/indoor flags (env.venue_geo: altitude, roof). RULES is spurious (no rule text read) and WEATHER_OBS>court_speed_env is not the altitude/roof source.

ten.draw.rationale: Derived Monte Carlo (depends on surface rating, fatigue, round context) that needs the actual draw/bracket and seeding: ten.draws_order_of_play (PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE_ONLY) is missing from the mapped datasets; WEATHER_OBS is spurious ('surface'/'draw' keywords).

ten.schedule.rationale: Definition is order of play with timestamps plus rain forecast: ten.draws_order_of_play (vintaged schedules, 'schedule changes are not archived') is missing; the draft maps only weather datasets and so reports COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED/PIT_SAFE too optimistically.

ten.motivation.rationale: Points to defend, ranking distance to cutoffs and event tier are in ten.matches (rank_points, tourney_level) plus weekly ten.rankings_history and points tables (reference); AVAIL>withdrawals is spurious because withdrawal/retirement base rates come from W/O/RET in scores, so PIT_UNAVAILABLE is wrong.

ten.rankings.rationale: Race position and points-to-defend need weekly dated ranking lists (ten.rankings_history, Sackmann rankings files; FREE_UNPROBED) not only match-row rank fields; draft COMPUTED_FULL is optimistic for the race/points-to-defend components.

ten.tiebreak.rationale: Derived: P(tiebreak win) from spw/rpw point model plus Markov P(6-6) so depends on ten.hold_break; RULES is spurious (matched the word 'tiebreak'; tiebreak scores are in ten.matches).

ten.break_points.rationale: bpSaved/bpFaced per player are columns of ten.matches (break points created = opponent bpFaced, converted = bpFaced-bpSaved); EVENT>ten.point_charting (SAMPLE_ONLY) is spurious (matched 'break point').

ten.decider_record.rationale: Derived: conversion is measured against pre-match Elo (own model) so inherits ten.surface_rating; score strings are in ten.matches.

ten.round_context.rationale: Derived: expected opponent Elo for later rounds and seeds depend on ten.surface_rating; round/seed columns are in ten.matches.

ten.first_serve.rationale: 1stIn, 1stWon, 2ndWon, svpt per match are in ten.matches; EVENT>point_charting (sample-only) and WEATHER_OBS (word 'surface'; surface is a matches column) are spurious.

ten.opp_adjusted_serve_return.rationale: Derived from ten.serve_return and ratings; needs only match-level serve stats; EVENT>point_charting, WEATHER_OBS and NEWS (spurious) make PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY wrong.

ten.surface_similarity.rationale: Derived from surface-specific ratings (ten.surface_rating/cross_surface_rating_covariance); inputs are match results by surface in ten.matches; point_charting and court_speed_env needs are spurious.

ten.rating_uncertainty.rationale: Derived: rating deviation of ten.surface_rating (returning/young/low-sample), raw is match history in ten.matches.

ten.venue_speed_history.rationale: Definition is event-year hold%, ace%, tiebreak% and mean games vs surface average: all derivable from ten.matches by tourney/year. RULES and court_speed_env needs are spurious (no rule text, no index required).

ten.ball_type_pressure.rationale: raw_data requires an event-year ball-brand register, which is not in ten.matches (no ball field) or any dataset; draft DATA_IN_HAND is optimistic. It is a hand-curated reference document.

ten.heat_humidity.rationale: Wet-bulb/heat-index forecast needs env.weather_forecast_pit (history ~2022+) and historical observed weather env.weather_observed to relate to retirement rates (from RET in ten.matches); AVAIL>withdrawals feed is spurious.

ten.wind_indoor.rationale: Roof/indoor state is a venue attribute (env.venue_geo roof) missing from the mapped needs; historical wind needs env.weather_observed in addition to the forecast.

ten.second_serve_vulnerability.rationale: raw_data is 2ndWon, svpt, 1stIn per player, all columns of ten.matches; EVENT>point_charting (sample-only) is spurious.

ten.handedness.rationale: winner_hand/loser_hand are in ten.matches; Elo-based matchup is derived from ten.surface_rating; WEATHER_OBS>court_speed_env is spurious ('surface').

ten.break_point_luck.rationale: Derived: regression of conversion/save on expected rates from ten.break_points; bpFaced/bpSaved are in ten.matches; EVENT>point_charting is spurious.

ten.first_serve_in_variance.rationale: Match-level SD of 1st-in% uses per-match 1stIn/svpt in ten.matches (raw statement 'historical match stats'); EVENT>point_charting is spurious.

ten.travel_timezone.rationale: Time-zone shift needs venue coordinates/time zone: env.venue_geo (has time zone), not ten.court_speed_env; player prior-event location comes from ten.matches tourney rows.

ten.qualifying_path_fatigue.rationale: Qualifying matches are not in ten.matches (miss: 'qualifying/challenger/ITF in separate files'); EVENT>point_charting does not hold qualifying either. Needs the Sackmann qualifying/Challenger files.

ten.retirement_base_rate.rationale: Retirement/walkover rates come from RET/W/O in score strings of ten.matches (PIT-safe by date); AVAIL>withdrawals (vintaged feed) is spurious ('retirement rate' keyword) so PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY is wrong.

ten.withdrawal_signals.rationale: Signals are practice, press and order of play: needs timestamped news (xx.news_timestamped) and order-of-play snapshots (ten.draws_order_of_play), not EVENT>ten.point_charting.

ten.prize_money_incentive.rationale: Prize money and ranking-points incentives are in published prize/points tables (ten.rules_formats_awards reference), not withdrawal feed; AVAIL is spurious so COLLECT_PROSPECTIVE/PIT_UNAVAILABLE is too pessimistic.

ten.retirement_settlement_rules.rationale: raw_data is rules_primary text per market (mkt.kalshi_rules); AVAIL>withdrawals is spurious ('retirement' keyword).

ten.home_crowd.rationale: Derived (pre-match Elo from ten.surface_rating); host country needs venue country (env.venue_geo), not court-speed pages.

ten.within_match_dependence.rationale: Derived: overdispersion is measured against the iid game model of ten.hold_break; games-per-set from ten.matches.

ten.ace_opp_adjusted.rationale: Aces/dfs/svpt are in ten.matches; WEATHER_OBS>court_speed_env is spurious (word 'surface'). Opponent adjustment builds on ten.serve_return.

ten.match_length_expectation.rationale: Derived simulation (hold_break, set_dist, retirement truncation); DRAFT>xx.draft_boards_vintaged and EVENT>point_charting are spurious (matched 'draw/prospect' words), so PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY is wrong.

ten.double_fault_pressure.rationale: Definition includes break-point and trailing-state effects and wind: DF by point state needs point-level charting (ten.point_charting, sample-only) and observed wind; ten.matches only has match-level df/bpFaced, so COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED/PIT_SAFE is optimistic.

ten.ace_settlement_source.rationale: raw_data is rules text/source_of_record per market: only mkt.kalshi_rules is needed; box score/team/rules-doc needs are spurious.

ten.path_difficulty_sim.rationale: Derived bracket simulation (ten.draw, ten.surface_rating, ten.fatigue) requiring actual draws (ten.draws_order_of_play) and withdrawals; WEATHER_OBS spurious.

ten.bracket_correlation.rationale: Derived: 'uses joint simulation outputs' of ten.path_difficulty_sim; DATA_IN_HAND from ten.matches alone ignores that upstream dependency and the draw data.

ten.pre_draw_field.rationale: Entry lists before the draw are in ten.draws_order_of_play (vintaged, prospective only); not in ten.matches.

ten.nationality_field_strength.rationale: Derived: per-nation roster with simulation outputs -> depends on ten.path_difficulty_sim and ratings; entrants need draws (ten.draws_order_of_play), draft DATA_IN_HAND is optimistic.

ten.team_event_structure.rationale: Lineup selection (nominations by tie) is not in ten.matches (match rows only); needs announcements/nominations (timestamped news, ten.draws_order_of_play).

ten.points_defense_rolling.rationale: Derived: needs official dated ranking points (ten.rankings_history) and expected points from the draw simulation (ten.path_difficulty_sim); ten.matches rank_points alone is not an as-of points timeline with expiry.

ten.joint_event_correlation.rationale: Derived: joint simulation across events with shared player health state -> depends on ten.path_difficulty_sim and ten.health_persistence_between_events.

ten.tiebreak_reach_probability.rationale: Derived from game-level Markov chain (ten.hold_break, ten.within_match_dependence); DRAFT>xx.draft_boards_vintaged is spurious (keyword), PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY wrong.

ten.score_feed_latency.rationale: raw_data requires timestamped live score-feed events and Kalshi price changes after them: neither is in mkt.kalshi_rules; need own-captured feed timestamps and mkt.kalshi_prices (benchmark). COLLECT_FREE_MEASURED is optimistic.

ten.suspension_postponement_risk.rationale: Needs observed weather history (env.weather_observed), roof (env.venue_geo) and suspension/delay records (ten.draws_order_of_play: schedule changes not archived); AVAIL>withdrawals is the wrong dataset.

ten.surface_calendar.rationale: Matches played on the current surface in the last 60 days: all columns in ten.matches; WEATHER_OBS>court_speed_env spurious ('surface').

ten.ace_count_distribution.rationale: Derived from opponent-adjusted ace rates (ten.ace_opp_adjusted) and expected service points (ten.match_length_expectation); WEATHER_OBS spurious ('surface').

ten.aces_df.rationale: Definition takes expected service points from the match-length model: derived from ten.match_length_expectation; serve speed requires tracking (paid), leaving the draft partial.

ten.ranking_points_simulation.rationale: Derived simulation over remaining calendar (ten.path_difficulty_sim, ten.surface_rating) needing dated ranking lists (ten.rankings_history) and points tables; ten.matches alone insufficient.

ten.cross_surface_rating_covariance.rationale: Derived: covariance of surface ratings from ten.surface_rating; raw is match results with surface (ten.matches); WEATHER_OBS spurious.

ten.health_persistence_between_events.rationale: raw_data needs draw/entry lists and participation sequences incl. non-starts: only players who played appear in ten.matches; entries/withdrawals are in ten.draws_order_of_play/withdrawals (prospective).

ten.straight_set_share_curve.rationale: Derived from pre-match Elo (ten.surface_rating); score strings, best_of, tour, surface are in ten.matches; WEATHER_OBS spurious.

ten.in_match_spw_posterior.rationale: raw_data is point sequences with server and winner: only ten.point_charting (SAMPLE_ONLY); ten.matches has only match totals, so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong. Prior depends on ten.serve_return.

ten.court_side_point_asymmetry.rationale: raw_data is charted points with server, side (deuce/ad), winner: only in ten.point_charting (SAMPLE_ONLY, charted subset), not ten.matches.

ten.player_speed_slope.rationale: raw_data is match rows with tourney_name, surface, serve counts and event hold%: all in ten.matches; EVENT>point_charting and WEATHER_OBS are spurious so BLOCKED_SAMPLE_ONLY is too pessimistic. Derived from ten.venue_speed_history and ratings.

ten.level_transfer_offset.rationale: raw_data needs Challenger/ITF rows; ten.matches is main-tour only (miss: challenger/ITF in separate files). Also derived from ratings.

ten.doubles_pair_strength.rationale: raw_data is doubles match rows with 4 player ids; ten.matches registry description covers singles results/serve stats, doubles are separate Sackmann files. Derived from singles Elo (ten.surface_rating).

ten.exhibition_format_effort.rationale: raw_data says exhibition results (none free): no free source, so COLLECT_FREE_UNVERIFIED is optimistic.

ten.walkover_slot_hazard.rationale: Needs order-of-play snapshots (ten.draws_order_of_play), not ten.point_charting; W/O rows are in ten.matches.

ten.compatriot_collision_matrix.rationale: Needs draw positions (ten.draws_order_of_play) and per-match win probabilities from the model (ten.surface_rating/path_difficulty_sim); ten.matches has no draw positions, so DATA_IN_HAND is optimistic.

ten.team_tie_lineup_distribution.rationale: raw_data includes nominations (team announcements) which are not in ten.matches; only past lineups/results are.

ten.line_calling_regime.rationale: raw_data requires event-year line-calling regime flags (electronic/linesmen), absent from ten.matches; a reference register to encode.

ten.eligible_event_calendar.rationale: Needs calendar with entry deadlines/points (reference) and entry list status (ten.draws_order_of_play); WEATHER_OBS spurious.

ten.withdrawal_hazard_timeline.rationale: Needs entry-list snapshots, draw and order of play (ten.draws_order_of_play), not ten.point_charting.

ten.retirement_announcement_hazard.rationale: Announcement dates need timestamped news (xx.news_timestamped), rank history needs ten.rankings_history; EVENT>point_charting is spurious.

ten.remaining_race_arithmetic.rationale: raw_data: current points, expiry schedule, points table, remaining calendar -> dated ranking lists (ten.rankings_history) and points table (reference); ten.matches alone has no expiry schedule/calendar.

ten.major_participation_hazard.rationale: Slam entries (not only starts) are needed: non-starters/withdrawals are absent from ten.matches; entry lists in ten.draws_order_of_play.

ten.bo5_rating_premium.rationale: Derived: uses pre-match Elo (ten.surface_rating); best_of in ten.matches.

ten.ranking_publication_calendar.rationale: raw_data is ranking publication dates/times by week: ten.rankings_history (weekly dated lists) plus official times (reference); PLAYER_BOX>ten.matches does not hold publication dates.

ten.hold_gap_expected_margin.rationale: Serve points won/played and opponent return stats are match-level fields in ten.matches; EVENT>point_charting (sample-only) is spurious so BLOCKED_SAMPLE_ONLY is too pessimistic. Derived from ten.hold_break.

ten.game_margin_pmf_calibration.rationale: Derived: uses pre-match Elo (ten.surface_rating); set scores/tour/best_of/surface in ten.matches; WEATHER_OBS spurious.

ten.game_serial_dependence.rationale: raw_data is game-by-game winner and server within sets: ten.matches only has set scores and SvGms totals, so game sequences need ten.point_charting (SAMPLE_ONLY); DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

ten.set_count_distribution_by_edge.rationale: Derived from pre-match Elo (ten.surface_rating); WEATHER_OBS/RULES spurious (surface/format keywords; best_of is in ten.matches).

ten.hold_rate_uncertainty_propagation.rationale: raw_data is serve points won/played per player-surface with dates: ten.matches columns; EVENT>point_charting and WEATHER_OBS spurious. Derived from ten.hold_break.

ten.tiebreak_base_rate_by_event.rationale: raw_data is score strings by tournament, year, round: ten.matches; RULES need is spurious ('format' keyword).

ten.player_set_drop_propensity.rationale: Derived: set-drop beyond rating -> depends on ten.surface_rating.

ten.tiebreak_sweep_joint_table.rationale: Derived: uses pre-match hold estimates (ten.hold_break); scores in ten.matches; RULES spurious.

ten.tournament_set_drop_path.rationale: Derived: explicitly runs ten.path_difficulty_sim with ten.set_count_distribution_by_edge probabilities; ten.matches alone is not sufficient.

ten.within_match_serve_decay.rationale: raw_data is point-level server and winner by set: only ten.point_charting (SAMPLE_ONLY); ten.matches has minutes but not point sequences, DATA_IN_HAND is wrong.

ten.games_per_set_distribution.rationale: Derived from the pair's hold rates (ten.hold_break); set scores and serve counts in ten.matches.

ten.player_games_residual.rationale: Derived: residual vs model expectations from ten.game_margin_pmf_calibration/ten.hold_break.

ten.withdrawal_cascade_effect.rationale: Bracket slots and replacement history are in ten.draws_order_of_play (not in ten.matches or rules text).

ten.round_upset_calibration.rationale: Derived: pre-match Elo (ten.surface_rating); seed and round in ten.matches.

ten.in_event_rating_update.rationale: Derived: updates ten.surface_rating within an event using per-round stats.

ten.short_format_rules.rationale: TRACKING>tracking_commercial (paid) matched 'next gen' in 'Next Gen Finals' - spurious; needs only event rulebook (reference) and Next Gen Finals scores from ten.matches, so BLOCKED_PAID_ONLY is wrong.

ten.injury_comeback.rationale: Raw items are days since last match, retirements/withdrawals (RET/W/O in ten.matches) and protected-ranking flag (rankings); AVAIL vintage feed and EVENT charting are spurious so PIT_UNAVAILABLE_HISTORICALLY is wrong. Feeds retirement_base_rate.

m.lifecycle.rationale: raw_data is Kalshi market open/close/status and order-of-play start times: needs mkt.kalshi_rules (series metadata) and ten.draws_order_of_play, not the withdrawals feed.

m.strike_hit_rates.rationale: raw_data includes pre-close Kalshi mid at fixed horizon (market-derived price from mkt.kalshi_prices, benchmark only), not only rules text; the draft misses the market-derived component.

new_datasets.title: Qualifying, Challenger and ITF singles match files (Sackmann)
new_datasets.missingness: separate files from tour-level ten.matches; serve stats sparser at lower levels

new_datasets.title: Timestamped live score-feed events (own capture)
new_datasets.missingness: no historical archive; must be captured prospectively

new_datasets.title: ATP/WTA doubles match results (Sackmann doubles files)
new_datasets.missingness: separate from singles ten.matches; not profiled in registry

new_datasets.title: Exhibition event results and formats
new_datasets.missingness: no free structured source (catalog raw_data: none free)

registry_objections.objection: Registry miss text says challenger/qualifying/ITF are separate files and does not say doubles files are collected; many inputs (level_transfer_offset, qualifying_path_fatigue, doubles_pair_strength) were mapped to ten.matches regardless. Also ten.matches carries no game-by-game sequences or draw positions.

Used as the VENUE/WEATHER_OBS target for generic 'surface'/'altitude'/'travel' keywords; its content (scraped court-speed index pages) does not supply time zone, roof or country, which env.venue_geo does.
